summary: Learn to assess healthcare data, interpret model results and report findings with practical case exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Data science in healthcare uses statistical and computational methods to examine clinical and service data and answer defined care or operational questions. For healthcare analysts, clinical quality staff and service managers, the course covers defining cohorts, checking data quality and summarizing service measures in Excel. Participants also practise interpreting sensitivity, specificity and calibration, reviewing model reports, and mapping clinical data fields to concepts in healthcare data standards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for healthcare professionals who work with clinical, quality or service data and need a grounded foundation in analysis. It suits people who review evidence for care teams, operational leads or executive decision-makers.
modules: HL7 FHIR and Clinical Data Context
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with healthcare records, service measures or clinical workflows is helpful. No coding or programming is required; exercises use Excel and structured case materials.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
